title: Visit London — New Year’s Day 2027 route and travel planning

facts.fact: The 2027 visitor guide confirms the route through Trafalgar Square and Whitehall and advises arrival planning for busy viewing areas.
facts.excerpt: before continuing through St James's, Pall Mall, Trafalgar Square and Whitehall
facts.location: Where is the best place to see the New Year’s Day Parade?

facts.fact: The official visitor guide advises reduced rail/Tube services on 1 January and venue-specific bank-holiday hours, rather than assuming all attractions have normal service.
facts.excerpt: Many Tube and train services run on a reduced schedule on 1 January
facts.location: Parade Top tip; later What’s open recommends checking each venue
